status: Qualified native dense F16 shared FFN component; whole goal remains active

implementation.arithmetic: Source dense FP16 gate/up GEMMs, half2 SiLU/product and clipping boundaries, then full-geometry F32 down GEMM. F32 routed+shared addition is captured independently but not part of this callback.
implementation.ownership: Borrow backend-owned immutable packed F16 weights; five request-local disjoint activation views; two independent request streams/workspaces. No GPU handles on CPU weights or shared model state.
implementation.workspace: Reuse linear_f16_reserve:32MiB FP16 handle plus existing16MiB trellis F32 handle; no additional hidden scratch.
implementation.validation: Validate all three projections, dimensions/types/owners/counts, entire activation lifetime aliases, clip finite0..65504, even hidden width, half2 alignment and launch bounds before any queued math.
implementation.source_scope: Pinned Deepseek GatedMLP shared expert is FP16 and has no BC/multiGu path; this qualifies its default shared FFN including small rows. It does not qualify routed <=8 specialized BC decode.

references.capture_policy: 332 source cases captured before native implementation/testing. A subsequent source-only coverage audit found limit10 inactive;20 additional scaled-input cases capture active clipping independently, before any native full corpus run. Both original corpora unchanged; combined manifests reference all originals without copying or replacing.
references.weight_provenance: 120 actual shared matrices from independently captured FP8 E8M0→F16 source dequantization, hashes verified; native probe uses model-owned core checkpoint preparation for all330 matrices and borrows shared role handles.
references.library_policy: Original packaged cuBLAS13.1 and paired system13.10 captures both preserved. Native matches paired corpus. Paired Python maps both bundled and preloaded libraries; ELF interposition follows the existing paired reference protocol.

profile.scope: Actual layer0 R64 clipping10; setup/uploads/host reference IO outside capture. This measures resident execution, not complete MoE or vLLM performance.

qualification.prior_attempts: Preserved before-active-clipping and before-selector-fix: unused corpus clipping branch prompted independent extra source cases; focused selector missing return was fixed after its fallthrough reached an unrelated legacy reference assertion. No reference values replaced.

limits: Full MoE fused/heavy/shared scheduling and production store ownership integration remain incomplete.
Native full forward/generation/CLI, compressed/indexed/shared-KV attention and Engram remain unadmitted.
Current callback excludes bias, residual addition and odd hidden widths; source model uses even hidden width and no shared bias.
Source routed <=8 specialized decode profile remains separate and unported.
Actual reference inputs are synthetic activations through real weights; no full-model accuracy claim.
Resident kernel timings are diagnostic; no matched vLLM throughput/decode or serving tail-latency claim.
